  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Assignment" name="Facility assignment"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Appointment" name="Appointment" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RepairCompleted" name="Repair completed" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted" targetRef="Catch_RepairCompleted"/>

  <!-- Customer -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendSymptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms">

    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FacilityRepaired" name="Repair delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repairing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F_NoRepair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Obtain additional parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendPartsNeeded" name="Send additional parts needed notice" messageRef="Msg_PartsNeeded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F_Loop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="Start_Facility" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveAssignment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F2" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveAssignment" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F3" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="SendTask_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="Task_ArriveAtCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F5" sourceRef="Task_ArriveAtCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_Repairable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_Repair" name="Repairable" sourceRef="Gateway_Repairable" targetRef="Task_RepairFridge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairable == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_NoRepair" name="Additional parts needed" sourceRef="Gateway_Repairable" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted" targetRef="End_FacilityRepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F8" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F9" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="SendTask_SendPartsNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_Loop" name="Return with parts" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPartsNeeded" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F_NoRepair</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="Start_Facility" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveAssignment"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="Task_ArriveAtCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F5" sourceRef="Task_ArriveAtCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_Repairable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_Repair" name="Repairable" sourceRef="Gateway_Repairable" targetRef="Task_RepairFridge">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_NoRepair" name="Needs additional parts" sourceRef="Gateway_Repairable" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted" targetRef="End_FacilityRepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F8" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F9" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="SendTask_SendPartsNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F10" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPartsNeeded" targetRef="Catch_PartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_Loop" name="Return with parts" sourceRef="Catch_PartsArrived" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineFridgeType" name="Determine fridge type">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F_Repaired</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F7</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F8</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendPartsNeeded" name="Send additional parts needed notice" messageRef="Msg_PartsNeeded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F9</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order additional parts">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PartsDelivered" name="Additional parts delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F_Loop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annot_Interaction">
      <bpmn:text>Each local service facility has its own way of interacting with customers</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="Start_Facility" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveAssignment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F2" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveAssignment" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F3" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="SendTask_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="Task_ArriveAtCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F5" sourceRef="Task_ArriveAtCustomer" targetRef="Task_AttemptRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" sourceRef="Task_AttemptRepair" targetRef="Gateway_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_Repaired" name="Repaired" sourceRef="Gateway_Repaired" targetRef="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_NeedsParts" name="Needs additional parts" sourceRef="Gateway_Repaired" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted" targetRef="End_FacilityRepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F8" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="SendTask_SendPartsNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F9" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPartsNeeded" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F10" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Catch_PartsDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_Loop" name="Return with parts" sourceRef="Catch_PartsDelivered" targetRef="Task_ArriveAtCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:association id="Assoc_Interaction" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="Annot_Interaction"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_Rate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerDone" name="Service completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C_NoRate</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_FridgeNoise" targetRef="Gateway_Prepare_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Gateway_Prepare_Split" targetRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Gateway_Prepare_Split" targetRef="Task_DetermineFridgeType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms" targetRef="Gateway_Prepare_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_DetermineFridgeType" targetRef="Gateway_Prepare_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Gateway_Prepare_Join" targetRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveAppointment" targetRef="Catch_RepairCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="Catch_RepairCompleted" targetRef="Task_ConfirmRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmRepair" targetRef="Gateway_RateChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Rate" name="Customer rates" sourceRef="Gateway_RateChoice" targetRef="Task_RateFacility">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${rateFacility == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_NoRate" name="Does not rate" sourceRef="Gateway_RateChoice" targetRef="End_CustomerDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="Task_RateFacility" targetRef="End_CustomerDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Central Fridge Service Center -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Center" name="Central Fridge Service Center" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Center" name="Symptoms received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_D1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveSymptoms" name="Receive symptoms and fridge type" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_D1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_D2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFacility" name="Select local service facility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_D2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_D3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendAssignment" name="Send assignment to facility" messageRef="Msg_Assignment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_D3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_D4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Center" name="Facility assigned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_D4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_D1" sourceRef="Start_Center" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_D2" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveSymptoms" targetRef="Task_SelectFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_D3" sourceRef="Task_SelectFacility" targetRef="SendTask_SendAssignment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_D4" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAssignment" targetRef="End_Center"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Local Service Facility -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Local Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Each local service facility has its own way of interacting with customers.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Facility" name="Assignment received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveAssignment" name="Receive assignment" messageRef="Msg_Assignment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeAppointment" name="Make appointment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendAppointment" name="Send appointment to customer" messageRef="Msg_Appointment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FacilityArrives" name="Facility arrives at customer (random time)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F_PartsLoop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairFridge" name="Repair fridge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Repaired" name="Fridge repaired?" default="Flow_F_NotRepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F_Repaired</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F_NotRepaired</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted" name="Send repair completed notice" messageRef="Msg_RepairCompleted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F_Repaired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FacilityRepaired" name="Repair delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repairing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F_NotRepaired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order additional parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PartsArrived" name="Additional parts arrived">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F_PartsLoop</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="Start_Facility" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveAssignment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F2" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveAssignment" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F3" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="SendTask_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="Catch_FacilityArrives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F5" sourceRef="Catch_FacilityArrives" targetRef="Task_RepairFridge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="Gateway_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_Repaired" name="Repaired" sourceRef="Gateway_Repaired" targetRef="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${fridgeRepaired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_NotRepaired" name="Needs additional parts" sourceRef="Gateway_Repaired" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRepairCompleted" targetRef="End_FacilityRepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F8" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F9" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Catch_PartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F_PartsLoop" name="Return with parts" sourceRef="Catch_PartsArrived" targetRef="Catch_FacilityArrives"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that, while other activities are under way, a participant performs a further preparation step of its own (for example, readying an item in parallel with the work of others): Model that described step as its own task on a parallel branch that starts at the same split as the concurrent activities, and join it with those branches before the step that depends on all of them. Do not drop the step or fold it into another task.
rules.situation: the description says that a participant prepares several pieces of information separately (one of them while another activity such as describing a problem is under way) and then sends them together in one message

rules.instruction: When the description says an action requests something from an outside party or source, and a later step can only proceed once that party's arrival or delivery happens at an unspecified or uncertain time: Model the request as its own task. Model the arrival or delivery as a distinct intermediate catch event placed after the request task and before the step that depends on it. Do not merge the request and the arrival into one element, do not represent the wait as a task or as internal work of another activity, and do not omit the request task. If the request is made on a parallel branch, keep the catch event on the path that leads to the dependent step.
rules.situation: the description says an action requests something from an outside party or source, and a later step can only proceed once that party's arrival or delivery happens at an unspecified or uncertain time
rules.source: learned guideline (refines ACT-05), generalized from EXS-089

rules.instruction: When the description states that after a scheduled appointment an external party arrives at an unspecified time, and that the visit may end without the goal achieved, so the next step depends on whether the goal was reached: Model the scheduling task, then an intermediate catch event for the arrival of the external party, placed directly after the scheduling task and before the activity performed on arrival. Model the activity performed on arrival as a task followed directly by an exclusive gateway with one conditional outgoing flow per stated result. Route the achieved result to the next step or the end event, and route the incomplete result back to the wait for the missing condition or to the earlier step that must be retried. Do not use an event-based gateway after the activity, because no event is awaited at that point; the result is produced by the activity itself.
rules.situation: the description states that after a scheduled appointment an external party arrives at an unspecified time, and that the visit may end without the goal achieved, so the next step depends on whether the goal was reached

rules.instruction: When The description says a party whose visit has already been arranged will arrive at an unpredictable time, and that on arrival the work may be left unfinished and must be taken up again on a later visit.: Model the arrival as an intermediate catch event placed after the arrangement task and before the work task. After the work task, place an exclusive gateway with one branch that continues when the work is completed and one branch that returns to the arrival catch event when the work is unfinished. Do not model the outcome as an event-based gateway, because the outcome is a data-based result of the work and not a race between events.
rules.situation: The description says a party whose visit has already been arranged will arrive at an unpredictable time, and that on arrival the work may be left unfinished and must be taken up again on a later visit.

promoted.trigger: The description says that an activity can start only when a previously agreed occurrence takes place at a time not known in advance, and that the activity may end incomplete so that the waiting must be repeated.
promoted.instruction: Model the waiting for the occurrence as an intermediate catch event placed after the preceding agreement task and before the activity. After the activity, place an exclusive gateway with one branch that continues when the activity is completed and one branch that returns to the catch event when the activity is incomplete. Do not model the outcome as an event-based gateway, since the outcome is a data-based result of the activity and not a race between events.
promoted.detail: general form of EXS-114, written after it improved the model of example 42
